exposure: mifepristone followed by misoprostol on the same day
mifepristone followed by misoprostol 1 day later
mifepristone followed by misoprostol 2 days later
outcome: proportion of terminated pregnancies after 24 hours
cohort: The study participants were 481 pregnancies undergoing second and third trimester termination of pregnancy (TOP) due to fetal anomalies between 2007 and 2017.
finding: A 1 day interval between mifepristone and misoprostol is more effective in second and third trimester TOP compared to other strategies in terms of reducing the induction to abortion interval.
